profile_text.body:
Luma AI is a creative AI platform founded in 2021 and headquartered in Redwood City, California. The company describes itself as focused on video generation and image creation, and positions its technology for use by agencies and brands handling end-to-end creative workflows.

The company's platform is built around two video generation models, Ray and Uni, alongside what it calls creative agents. Uni-1 is described as a brand intelligence model capable of carrying style references, character references, and visual grounding into generated assets. The site also notes a collaboration between Wonder Project and Luma AI to combine generative AI with traditional filmmaking through a production services venture.

The site's held facts show Luma AI has 174 cases associated with California legal exposure, though no specific litigation details are provided in the available data. The company's primary tracked product is its video and 3D generation platform at lumalabs.ai.
